 Manila Fuel prices to roll back again on November 17 
 Image from Pixabay Third Anne Peralta-Malonzo Published on :  Nov 16, 2026, 8:10 am 
 Copied 
 THERE will be another fuel price rollback on Tuesday, November 17, 2026.
 The Department of Energy (DOE) said gasoline prices will drop by P1.50 per liter, diesel by P3.80 per liter, and kerosene by P5.80 per liter.
 The agency noted that the adjustments reflect movements in the global oil market amid ongoing developments in the Middle East affecting international supply and prices. (TPM/SunStar Philippines)
